integrationNotes: DLSS-NR-on-AMD v0.9.0 is distributed via NeuralHub_v0.9.0_setup.exe under a personal non-commercial license prohibiting redistribution or patching. Users acquire NeuralHub from official GitHub Releases and import their legitimate local nvngx_dlssnr.dll into NeuralHub or link verified runtime files.

CC.notes: 40-80% faster Neural Rendering model added in DLSS-NR-on-AMD v0.9.0; requires nvngx_dlssnr.dll 310.9.16.0 or newer.

HT.notes: Standard DLSS 5 Neural Rendering model; requires nvngx_dlssnr.dll 310.8.0.0 or newer.

optionalCompanionDlls.notes: Optional DLSS Super Resolution DLL; not interchangeable with nvngx_dlssnr.dll.
Optional DLSS Frame Generation DLL; DLSS-FG is explicitly unavailable on RX 6000 (RDNA 2) in v0.9.0.
Optional DLSS Ray Reconstruction DLL (Model F targets RDNA 3 / RDNA 4).

rdna2Notes: AMD official HIP SDK 7.2 Windows requirements (https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/install-on-windows/en/docs-7.2/reference/system-requirements.html) exclude RX 6600 / gfx1032. DLSS-NR-on-AMD v0.9.0 provides an experimental RDNA 2 HIP path (Superfast / Fast modes only; Reference mode and DLSS-FG are unavailable on RX 6000).
